info.title: GemstoneAI Enterprise API
info.description:
The GemstoneAI Enterprise API: the pricing and verification layer for jewelry.

The **Scan API** is the business version of a GemstoneAI scan result. Send photos of a piece
of jewelry or a loose stone, its details, or both, and get back what it is and what it's worth:
the identification (observations, alternatives, open questions, next evidence), a price range in
your chosen valuation basis, a Raw/Make/Market breakdown for pieces, the comparables behind it
(each tagged as a realized sale or an asking price), a confidence score with reason codes, and
scenario pricing for unknowns such as natural vs lab-grown.

* **Authentication:** `Authorization: Bearer gsk_...` (or `X-API-Key`). Keys are scoped per product.
* **Sandbox:** `gsk_test_` keys run against simulated identification and synthetic comparables;
  responses carry `synthetic_data: true`.
* **No guessing:** an item that can't be identified well enough (`unidentified`), or fewer than 5
  qualifying comparables (`insufficient_data`), means no price.
* **Audit:** every scan is stored and retrievable by `scan_id`.
* **Reproducibility:** every response is stamped with `model_version`; pin one per request or per account.
* **Idempotency:** send `Idempotency-Key` on POSTs to make retries safe.

post.summary: Scan a piece of jewelry or a loose stone
post.description: The business version of a GemstoneAI scan result. Send 1-5 photos of one item, the item's details, or both (stated details always win over what the photos suggest). Returns the identification (summary, observations, alternatives, open questions and the next evidence that would settle them), then the price: a low/mid/high range in the requested valuation basis (also per carat for loose stones), a Raw/Make/Market breakdown for pieces, the comparables used (each tagged realized sale or asking price), a confidence score with reason codes, and scenario pricing for unknowns. **No guessing:** an item that cannot be identified well enough returns `unidentified`, and fewer than 5 qualifying comparables returns `insufficient_data`, both with no price. If identification is still running the response is `202` with `status: processing`; retrieve the scan with `GET /scans/{scan_id}`. Every scan is stored and retrievable.

post.summary: Submit a CSV of items to scan in batch
post.description: Upload a CSV (multipart field `file`), one item per row. Columns: `row_id`, `photo_urls` (up to 5 public https links separated by `|`), `item_type` (default `loose_stone` when a row has no photos), `valuation_basis`; center or loose stone: `variety`, `species`, `carat`, `shape`, `color_grade`, `clarity`, `cut_grade`, `treatment`, `origin`, `growth`, `lab`, `lab_report_number`, `length_mm`, `width_mm`, `depth_mm`; side stones: `side_variety`, `side_carat_total`, `side_count`, `side_growth`; metal: `metal_type`, `metal_purity`, `metal_color`, `metal_weight_grams`; piece: `brand`, `signed`, `era`, `condition`. The header must include `photo_urls`, `variety`, `item_type` or `metal_type`. The job runs asynchronously; poll the status endpoint, then download the results CSV. The whole batch is pinned to one model version.

valuation_basis.title: Valuation Basis
valuation_basis.description: Default basis for rows without a valuation_basis column.

value.title: Value
value.description: Share of the mid total, in the requested basis.

source_type.title: Source Type
source_type.description: 'realized' = completed sale; 'asking' = list price, not a transaction.

adjusted_price_per_carat.title: Adjusted Price Per Carat
adjusted_price_per_carat.description: Engine adjustment toward the subject (loose stones).

url.title: Url
url.description: Link to the listing or sale record.

differences.title: Differences
differences.description: How the comparable differs from this item.

basis_factor.title: Basis Factor
basis_factor.description: Multiplier applied to reach the requested basis.

basis_price_total.title: Basis Price Total
basis_price_total.description: What this comp implies for the subject, in the requested basis.

qualified.title: Qualified
qualified.description: True when the comp met the similarity threshold.

rejected.title: Rejected
rejected.description: Comps dropped for missing source_type or invalid data.

source.title: Source
source.description: What the identification is based on.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Null when the item was described, not photographed.

alternatives.title: Alternatives
alternatives.description: Other things it could be, with probability.

next_evidence.title: Next Evidence
next_evidence.description: The evidence or testing that would settle them.

field_sources.title: Field Sources
field_sources.description: For each item field used, whether you stated it or it was identified.

photos.title: Photos
photos.description: Photo metadata (sha256, media type, size, url).

type.title: Type
type.description: gold, platinum, silver, palladium or other.

url.title: Url
url.description: Public https link to the photo.

PhotoInput.title: PhotoInput
PhotoInput.description: A photo of the item: a public https URL, or base64 image data with its media type.

per_carat.description: Loose stones only; null for pieces.

item_type.title: Item Type
item_type.description: A loose stone or a kind of finished piece. Required without photos.

stones.title: Stones
stones.description: Exactly one stone for a loose stone; any number (including none) for a piece.

metal.description: Not allowed for a loose stone.

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: Maker or house, e.g. a jewelry maison.

signed.title: Signed
signed.description: True if the piece bears the maker's signature or mark.

photos.title: Photos
photos.description: 1-5 photos of the same item: front, side, and any stamps inside the band or on the clasp. Optional when the item's details are given in full.

description.title: Description
description.description: Free text, stored for audit; not used for pricing.

valuation_basis.title: Valuation Basis
valuation_basis.description: The value definition the price range is expressed in.

model_version.title: Model Version
model_version.description: Pin a model version (overrides the account's pin). See GET /models.

status.title: Status
status.description: priced | insufficient_data (fewer than 5 comps, no price) | unidentified (the item could not be identified well enough to price) | processing.

synthetic_data.title: Synthetic Data
synthetic_data.description: True when computed in the sandbox from synthetic data (not market values).

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: The request as received, with photo metadata.

breakdown.description: Raw/Make/Market split of the mid value, for pieces.

carat.title: Carat
carat.description: Weight of the stone, or total weight of the group if count > 1.

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: Cut shape, e.g. 'round', 'oval'. Required for a loose stone.

color_grade.title: Color Grade
color_grade.description: e.g. 'G' for diamonds, 'vivid' for colored stones.

treatment.title: Treatment
treatment.description: Omit when unknown; colored stones then get scenario pricing per treatment. Synonyms accepted ('unheated', 'no heat', 'minor oil').

growth.title: Growth
growth.description: 'natural' or 'lab_grown'. Omit when unknown; diamonds then get both scenarios.

StoneInput.title: StoneInput
StoneInput.description: One stone, or a group of identical stones (e.g. 12 side diamonds, 0.40 ct total).

HTTPBearer.description: Enterprise API key as a bearer token.
